$comment: Cross-fragment changes proposed by the agent that owns data/64-metals-d.json. Nothing here has been applied. Every `to` is an id defined in this fragment (metal.tantalum is a branch root, metal.columbite and metal.tantalum.separation are `shared` entries), so all three are safe, stable merge targets. See docs/CHECKLIST.md sections 4 and 8 before applying. Tantalum family, one pass, 2026-10-05: both ends of every pair re-read in full; description > note > from/inputs evidence order throughout.

merges.why: Same substance at the same level: capacitor-grade tantalum metal/powder. metal.tantalum ('Tantalum powder for electrolytic capacitors', high, 724-char description, 4 facts: 99.9%+ purity; columbite-tantalite (Fe,Mn)(Nb,Ta)2O6 at 10-40% Ta2O5; genuine 1982-83 disruption with doubled price and niobium substitution; capacitor-grade powder via milling and sodium reduction) vs metal.tantalum.powder ('Tantalum powder', high, 570-char description, 5 facts: 1200-1400 C vacuum sinter at 30-50% porosity; Ta2O5 anodisation to 2-4x working voltage in phosphoric or nitric acid; 1-8 um classification; MnO2 or later-1980s silver counter-electrode; bead and molded-chip packages in 1982 displacing wet slug). Keep-rule 1 near-tie on summed description+facts (1100 vs 1008); rule 3 decides for the general id metal.tantalum, which is also the branch root the metal root references. Re-point all four references at the survivor: the produces edge on metal.tantalum.separation and the made-of edges on mb.passives, mb.passives.caps.tantalum and mb.passives.caps.tantalum.dielectric.forming-voltage.cathode-body. Survivor adopts no children (loser has none). Facts union for the central text edit: carry the Pellet, Anodisation, Counter-electrode and In-1982 facts plus the tantalum-capacitor source and the silver-electrode timing note onto the survivor. Three conflicts, keep more specific + other in note: (a) particle size 1-8 um (loser) vs 2-10 um on mb.passives.caps.tantalum.anode - keep the anode range, put 1-8 um in note; (b) 'bipolar electrolytic part with no liquid' (loser description) vs 'polarised capacitor' on mb.passives.caps.tantalum - keep polarised; (c) 'handful of tantalum capacitors on the mainboard' (survivor description) vs the repaired note on mb.passives.caps.tantalum ('the breadbin C64 250407 uses aluminium electrolytics and ceramics, NOT tantalum on its logic') - keep the note, correct the survivor description on apply.

Same ore at the same level. metal.columbite ('Columbite-tantalite concentrate', high, 3 facts: 20-60% Ta2O5 rich fraction; Greenbushes pegmatite host; refractory oxide in silicate rock; Greenbushes/Wodgina/Cat Creek/Oarkopper/Congo/Nigeria/Zimbabwe geography plus Malaysian/Brazilian tin-slag secondary source; metal.columbite.mine child) vs mb.passives.caps.tantalum.ore-to-powder.columbite-ore ('Columbite-tantalite ore', high, 973-char description, zero facts: placer gravels and lode pegmatites; gravity/magnetic/electrostatic plus acid leach; 10-30% Ta2O5 concentrate; cost in mining not chemistry; Kivu artisanal/alluvial supply and Congo/Rwanda-Burundi exposure). Keep-rule 1 for the metals node (facts plus a mine subtree against a bare leaf); rules 2 and 3 agree (canonical shared metals node, general id over the five-segment path-local id). Re-point the single consumes edge on mb.passives.caps.tantalum.ore-to-powder at the survivor. Fold the loser's placer/alluvial mining, Kivu/Rwanda-Burundi geography and cost-in-mining sentences plus the coltan source and the DRC conflict-mineral timing note into the survivor; on the concentrate-grade overlap (10-30% vs survivor 20-60% rich fraction and concentrator 20-30%) keep the survivor figures.

The passives ore-to-powder node ('Columbite ore to capacitor-grade powder', medium, 3 facts, no children, zero incoming references in the built tree) compresses digestion + precipitation + reduction into one summary of the two-step metals chain metal.tantalum.hf-digest -> metal.tantalum.separation (high, 840-char description, 4 facts, metal.tantalum.kcl-cycle child: K2TaF7 precipitation by KCl at 70-90 C with the K2TaF7/K2NbF7 solubility rationale; K/Na reduction at 700-800 C as the capacitor-grade norm; Al reduction at 700-900 C for bulk metal). Keep-rules 1 and 2 for the separation node; its digestion fact is already covered word-for-word by hf-digest (HF, 100-200 C), so nothing is lost there. No re-pointing needed (floating node). Fold the reduction-variants content (copper-chloride reduction, KCl/KF salt melt) into the survivor note. One chemistry conflict, keep more specific + other in note: loser precipitates 'K2Ta2O7 from KCl/KOH'; survivor precipitates K2TaF7 (temperature, solubility mechanism, two sources) - keep K2TaF7, put the K2Ta2O7 claim in note. Drop the loser's 'deliberately compressed...' note on apply (authoring-process commentary, CHECKLIST 7a).

note: Peripheral verdict: the 250407 mainboard (c64.mainboard children: mb.pcb/cpu/ram/color-ram/roms/vic/sid/cia/ppi/pla/discretes/logic/rf-modulator/passives/crystal) carries NO tantalum on its logic - the repaired note on mb.passives.caps.tantalum states the breadbin 250407 uses aluminium electrolytics and ceramics, and tantalum reaches the product only through the mb.passives catalogue hub (contains mlcc/alu-electrolytic/tantalum/ceramic-disc/film/mica/trim) plus a 0.22 uF 35 V bead on some external PSU-brick builds (c64.psu.aux-caps.tantalum, already merged into mb.passives.caps.tantalum and applied). So the tantalum ore-to-powder chain is correctly peripheral: reachable, era-real (professional boards, some brick builds, documented 1982-83 crisis), not board content. Scope recommendation: NO _scope.json change - survivors stay chain; the shortage commentary already sits at context on mb.passives.caps.tantalum.supply-crisis. Considered and NOT proposed: anode/wire/dielectric/packaging/anode.press (capacitor fabrication parts and steps, distinct levels from the powder commodity); supply-crisis and recycling (note/process commentary, not substances); thorium/tailings/concentrator/mine/pegmatite/digest-vessel/kcl-cycle (unique chain nodes, no doubles); metal.pegmatite-crystals vs metal.columbite.pegmatite (enrichment pockets vs dyke rock, child and parent, not duplicates); mb.passives.caps.tantalum.dielectric.manganese-chloride (MnCl2-vs-nitrate route dispute is intra-passives correctness with a Not-established note and no metals-side counterpart - left for the passives owner). Already applied, NOT re-proposed: c64.psu.aux-caps.tantalum, peripheral.tv.crt.vacuum.tantalum, metal.tantalum.monazite (all in _merged.json, none in tree). No _ingredients.json entry maps to any loser id. Verified: all six ids re-read in full on both ends; every `to` exists in public/tree.json; ASCII-only file.
